original.statement: The release bumps the markdown dependency from 3.7 to 3.8 in the /hack/api-docs documentation tooling, which is an internal build dependency with no stated effect on operators.

decision.reason: [ev-ad50e5e6820c] only says that dependabot bumped markdown from 3.7 to 3.8 in /hack/api-docs. That directory is the repository's API-docs generation tooling, not the shipped external-secrets product. Nothing in the evidence says deployed external-secrets depends on or interacts with markdown, so recording this as a product-relationship gives it an identity the text doesn't support, and no other subject family fits. The before/after literals also wrap the version in extra quotes ("\"3.7\"") instead of the plain 3.7 and 3.8 the text states.
